task: Repair Mavis raw capture after process exit

constraint.statement: An exited process could be released while its raw-output reader was still draining.

requirements.requirement: Initial exec preserves a complete burst after exit
evidence: Initial exec reference was complete and its raw file exactly equaled the 1.6 MB expected output

requirements.requirement: Interactive write_stdin preserves a complete burst after exit
evidence: Interactive reference was complete; raw bytes contained the full burst and byte count matched the file

requirements.requirement: Post-exit capture has a bounded failure path before an exited reference is returned
requirements.command: ZDOTDIR=<empty temporary directory> just test -p codex-core unified_exec
evidence: Source enforces a 30-second Mavis-only drain limit and returns ProcessFailed on timeout; 177 unified exec tests passed

requirements.requirement: Ordinary Codex retains its post-exit response behavior
requirements.command: ZDOTDIR=<empty temporary directory> just test -p codex-core unified_exec
evidence: The new wait is gated by presence of the Mavis raw spool; 177 unified exec tests passed
